$comment: AstroCS BLD-001 frozen toolchain presets. Formal Windows generator is Visual Studio 17 2022 (x64 / v143 host=x64 without a pinned MSVC build number / SDK 10.0.26100.0 / CMake 3.31.12) per 09_WINDOWS_TOOLCHAIN_LOCK.md. V8-CI-010 F-R3-02b: VS instance is discovered by cmake via vswhere (no CMAKE_GENERATOR_INSTANCE override); toolset carries no version= pin so the hosted mirror default v143 and the local VS default v143 both resolve. Machine validation: cmake/toolchain/verify_toolchain.py against packaging/schemas/preset-contract.schema.json.

windows_formal.note: cmakeMinimumRequired.patch is 0 so any 3.31.x parses the file; the exact 3.31.12 install pin is enforced by the toolchain verifier and machine acceptance.

configurePresets.name: base-msvc
configurePresets.description: Hidden base for the single formal Windows preset. VS 17 2022 x64 only, host x64, toolset v143 without a version pin (hosted mirror default / local VS default), SDK 10.0.26100.0, DLL CRT everywhere (/MD /MDd). VS instance is NOT pinned: cmake discovers it via vswhere (V8-CI-010 F-R3-02b — a hardcoded CMAKE_GENERATOR_INSTANCE local path made hosted configure fail in 0.4s). Never edits this preset to another generator.

configurePresets.name: win-msvc-17.14.39-x64
configurePresets.displayName: AstroCS Windows x64 正式发布工具链 (VS17 2022 v143 14.44.35207 SDK 26100)
configurePresets.description: 正式 Windows 构建：Visual Studio 17 2022 / x64 / host x64 / v143（不固定 build 号，cmake 经 vswhere 自动发现 VS 实例）/ Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0 / CMake 3.31.12 / C++17 / CRT /MD /MDd / ACR OFF。仅 AMD64；不含 Win32/ARM/ARM64。只在 Windows 主机生效。
